shared_elements: prominent eye(s) rendered as simple carved shapes
arms/hands brought against the front of the body
short stubby limbs projecting at the sides
shallow-relief detail on a boulder-shaped mass
justification: Both depict a schematic hunched bird-headed being whose beaked, big-eyed head sits directly atop a compact rounded body, with arms/hands drawn in against the chest and stubby limbs at the flanks — a fairly specific composite creature rather than a generic animal. The main differences are that A is a flat low-relief image with additional linear comb-like/rib-like markings and a single profile eye and beak facing sideways, while B is a frontal three-dimensional figure with paired eyes and a centred beak and no such linear infill.
